messages:
Eli Sales: Mark from FinCo asking if they can map their NAT'ed outbound IPs to our Dedicated POC endpoint instead of changing firewall rules.

Sam SE: Short answer: we can't attach customer-owned public IPs to our shared Dedicated pools. Options:
- We provide a small set of static outbound IPs for the POC window
- Private deployment / VPC peering so egress originates from their VPC
- Split-proxy: customer sends to their proxy which forwards to us (adds latency)

Mark (FinCo): Their policy forbids temporary hostnames; CIDR/IPs only. Will your static IPs be guaranteed for the window?

Jin NetEng: For POCs we can reserve fixed IPs that won't rotate during the agreed window. Will need 48h lead time and signed POC agreement.

Sam SE: We'll include an optional infra line on the quote for reserved IPs. No change to token pricing for the POC.

Mark (FinCo): Please send a one-page allowlist doc and a curl smoke test I can hand to our infra approvers.

Sam SE: Attaching sample allowlist text in the ticket and the curl snippet.

ops-bot: Support ticket #802210 created by @Sam SE, assigned to eng-net. ETA: 1 business day.

Eli Sales: Thanks team — Mark, we'll DM you the docs and the quote. :thumbsup:
